title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: The real reason DeFi projects that survived 2022 crash are shutting down now
summary: DeFi projects that survived the fallout from the Terra and FTX collapses in 2022 are dying out in 2026. But analysts say it’s not a case of industry consolidation — but the opposite.

title: Markets eye Bank of Japan meeting on Friday as yen repeats 40-year US dollar lows
summary: Analysis warned of a repeat of the 2024 yen carry-trade unwind that pressured crypto markets ahead of the next Bank of Japan interest-rate meeting.

title: Ethereum, Solana led crypto hack losses in H1 2026: Blockaid
summary: Blockaid found Ethereum remained the hardest-hit blockchain in H1 2026, while Solana replaced Arbitrum as the network with the second-highest losses, driven largely by key compromises.

title: PayPal expands stablecoin push as crypto assets factor into Q2 results
summary: PayPal highlighted growth of stablecoins and AI-driven payment tools in Q2 while reporting $8.68 billion in revenue and an $81 million crypto-related earnings adjustment.

title: 1inch moves to unite DeFi liquidity across 13 chains with Aqua
summary: Decentralized exchange aggregator 1inch announced the launch of its Aqua protocol allowing users to provide liquidity to many protocols at once.

title: IMF warns Brazil’s stablecoin activity outpaces traditional capital flows
summary: The IMF said Brazil’s stablecoin market has expanded rapidly since 2017, with cross-border crypto flows growing faster than traditional capital flows.

title: Lido upgrade aims to slash Ethereum’s validator count by one-third
summary: Lido launched Curated Module v2, an upgrade that could reduce Ethereum’s validator count by one-third by consolidating validators and introducing new operator rules.

title: Ondo shifts from layer-1 blockchain plan to offchain execution network
summary: The new system marks an apparent departure from the institution-focused layer-1 blockchain Ondo announced in 2025.

title: Apple faces lawsuit over alleged $1.8M Bitcoin wallet app losses
summary: Three users allege a fake Sparrow Wallet app on Apple’s App Store drained their Bitcoin holdings, with losses totaling more than $1.8 million.
